data.title: 木更 · 便利店日常
data.description: 【木更 · 便利店日常】深夜的便利店灯光明亮，木更提着购物篮沿着货架慢慢挑选，最后认真比较起几款能量饮料。她回头望向修，带着一贯的关切与期待——「今晚还要忙很久吗？饮料我来挑，不过忙完以后也要好好休息哦。」
data.location: 契约者公寓楼下便利店
data.action: 提着购物篮在便利店挑选能量饮料
data.camera: medium shot, picking snacks from illuminated store shelves
data.promptProse: Kisara carries a shopping basket through the late-night convenience-store snack aisle and chooses an energy drink with careful concentration. Casual jacket and jeans retain the errand outfit beneath long pink hair. The medium view includes the basket and illuminated drink rows, shelves continuing toward the rear of the store. Bright fluorescent lamps catch can rims and her selecting fingers, leaving soft shelf shadows and darker intervals behind the neatly stacked products.
